name: elastase, neutrophil expressed
pathways: positive regulation of MAP kinase activity
negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ELANE encodes neutrophil elastase. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and endopeptidase activity. It participates in positive regulation of MAP kinase activity and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to neutropenia (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
